project_context: Easy Forms is a modern, full-featured form builder and management platform enabling users to dynamically construct, publish, and analyze custom web forms with real-time analytics and automated export capabilities.

architecture.title: High Level
architecture.description: Frontend & Backend (Next.js App Router / React / TypeScript) ➔ Next.js API Routes ➔ Database & Redis Cache

architecture.title: Infrastructure
architecture.description: Next.js Full-Stack deployment paired with Redis for real-time pub/sub and state synchronization.

architecture.title: Design Paradigm
architecture.description: Modular component-driven architecture with serverless API route handlers and real-time event distribution.

architecture.title: Asset Delivery
architecture.description: Optimized static asset delivery and server-side rendering powered by Next.js.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Users needed an intuitive, code-free interface to build complex, customizable forms with custom field types.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Engineered a flexible, component-driven form builder allowing users to assemble, preview, and deploy custom form schemas effortlessly.

technical_details.title: Technical Details
items: Developed modular field components mapping to dynamic JSON schemas stored in the backend.
Implemented live form preview with support for responsive layouts and customizable styling options.
Integrated field-level validation and configurable field properties.

outcome.title: Impact
items: Empowered non-technical users to build and publish custom forms in minutes.
Reduced form creation and publishing lifecycle times significantly.

media.alt: Drag and drop form builder canvas

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Form creators needed instant, actionable insights into response completion rates, submission volumes, and data trends.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Constructed an interactive analytics dashboard that translates incoming form submissions into real-time visual charts and structured datasets.

technical_details.title: Technical Details
items: Integrated charting libraries to render key metrics such as submission counts, field distributions, and completion trends.
Utilized Redis pub/sub and WebSockets/SSE to trigger real-time UI updates upon new form submissions.

outcome.title: Impact
items: Eliminated page refreshes by delivering live data feeds direct to user dashboards.
Improved visibility into campaign performance with instant feedback loops.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Form managers needed flexible ways to extract gathered response data for offline analysis, reporting, and external processing.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Built an asynchronous multi-format export pipeline capable of outputting form submission datasets into CSV, JSON, and PDF documents.

technical_details.title: Technical Details
items: Created server-side data extraction routines optimized for batching large response sets.
Engineered document formatting layers to render structured PDF reports from raw response schemas.

outcome.title: Impact
items: Simplified reporting tasks by providing one-click data exports in standard industry formats.

problem.title: Problem
problem.description: Users required immediate alerts when high-value form responses were submitted or key thresholds were reached.

solution.title: Solution
solution.description: Implemented a dual in-app and email notification system powered by custom HTML templates and Redis event messaging.

technical_details.title: Technical Details
items: Designed transactional HTML email templates dynamically hydrated with submission data.
Utilized background service handlers to deliver real-time in-app alerts without blocking client API threads.

outcome.title: Impact
items: Enhanced user responsiveness to lead captures and submission events.
